title: Clawback-Size Surcharge Schedule — Wrong-Address Violations, Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts
content:
Under Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts, the clawback-size surcharge on a wrong-address violation follows the batch pay taken back for the order verified as not delivered, as the reversal entry in the Cartwise Shopper Batches pay ledger records it.

**Clause.** A clawback of $5.00 or more adds 2 points; a clawback from $2.50 up to but not including $5.00 adds 1 point; a smaller clawback adds nothing.

| Batch pay taken back for the order | Clawback-size surcharge |
|---|---|
| $5.00 or more | 2 points |
| $2.50 to $4.99 | 1 point |
| Less than $2.50 | Nothing |

## Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical reversals)

| Amount reversed | Surcharge |
|---|---|
| $5.00 | 2 points |
| $4.99 | 1 point |
| $2.50 | 1 point |
| $2.49 | Nothing |

The amount is the reversal amount on the ledger entry for that order, in US dollars.
